artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $d\ge 1$ and consider the Hilbert space $\ell^2(\mathbb{N}^d;\mathbb{C})$ with canonical orthonormal basis $\{e(n_1,\dots,n_d)\}_{n\in\mathbb{N}^d}$. Define annihilation and creation operators $a_j,a_k^*$ by closure from
$$a_j\,e(n_1,\dots,n_d)=\sqrt{n_j}\,e(n_1,\dots,n_j-1,\dots,n_d),\qquad a_k^*\,e(n_1,\dots,n_d)=\sqrt{n_k+1}\,e(n_1,\dots,n_k+1,\dots,n_d).$$
Let $\Omega=(\Omega_{jk})\in M_d(\mathbb{C})$ be Hermitian, $\kappa=(\kappa_{jk})\in M_d(\mathbb{C})$ be symmetric, $\zeta=(\zeta_j)\in\mathbb{C}^d$, and let $V=(v_{\ell k}),U=(u_{\ell k})$ be $2d\times d$ complex matrices. Define
$$H=\sum_{j,k=1}^d \Omega_{jk}\,a_j^* a_k+\sum_{j,k=1}^d\Big(\tfrac{\kappa_{jk}}{2}a_j^* a_k^*+\tfrac{\overline{\kappa}_{jk}}{2}a_j a_k\Big)+\sum_{j=1}^d\Big(\tfrac{\zeta_j}{2}a_j^*+\tfrac{\overline{\zeta_j}}{2}a_j\Big),$$
$$L_\ell=\sum_{k=1}^d\bigl(v_{\ell k} a_k+u_{\ell k} a_k^*\bigr),\qquad \ell=1,\dots,2d,$$
and let $G$ be the closure of $-iH-\tfrac12\sum_{\ell=1}^{2d}L_\ell^* L_\ell$. It is known that $G$ generates a $C_0$ contraction semigroup $P=(P_t)_{t\ge 0}$ on $\ell^2(\mathbb{N}^d;\mathbb{C})$. Assume the non-degeneracy condition
$$K=\begin{bmatrix} V^T\\ U^*\end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} V & U\end{bmatrix}=\begin{bmatrix} V^T V & V^T U\\ U^* V & U^* U\end{bmatrix}>0,$$
and assume the Hamiltonian $H$ is bounded from below (or from above). Is the semigroup $P$ analytic? More generally, characterize the set of parameters $(\Omega,\kappa,U,V,\zeta)$ for which $P$ is an analytic semigroup.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question regarding analyticity of Gaussian quantum Markov semigroups generated by quadratic GKSL operators. Recent works (2024–2025) on Gaussian QMSs, the Kossakowski matrix and strict positivity, and KMS spectral gaps discuss sufficient conditions (e.g. perturbation arguments when H is small relative to G₀) but do not provide a full classification or settle the analyticity question under only K>0 and semiboundedness of H. No source found resolving the problem in full generality.

status_evidence.title: The Kossakowski Matrix and Strict Positivity of Markovian Gaussian Semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: Strict positivity of the Kossakowski matrix implies positivity improving provided a certain semigroup is analytic; sufficient perturbative conditions are given.
status_evidence.claim: Recent work provides sufficient conditions but not a full classification of analyticity.

status_evidence.title: Gaussian quantum Markov semigroups on finitely many modes
status_evidence.snippet: Studies Gaussian QMSs with quadratic generators on bosonic Fock space.
status_evidence.claim: The classification problem of analyticity in terms of (Ω,κ,U,V,ζ) remains under active investigation.

status_evidence.title: On the Existence of the KMS Spectral Gap in Gaussian Quantum Markov Semigroups
status_evidence.snippet: Recent (2025) analysis of spectral properties of Gaussian QMSs.
status_evidence.claim: Active research on spectral/analytic properties continues, with no full resolution of the analyticity classification.
